responsibility: This header declares the text-art module’s CHECKING_P selftest entry points and test support helpers. It exposes the per-source-file test runners, the top-level text_art_tests dispatcher, and ASSERT_CANVAS_STREQ wrappers around canvas-to-pretty-printer comparison helpers so individual implementation files can register and use consistent rendering assertions.
same_name_distinction: Provides the CHECKING_P declarations and ASSERT_CANVAS_STREQ macro used across the module’s tests; unlike gcc/text-art/selftests.cc, it is the shared test interface, not the central test runner implementation.
